segments.text: October, nineteen eighty-seven. A strategy game spreads across the world, one Usenet post at a time.
In the computer centres of the universities, students compile it, and rule kingdoms of elves, dwarves, orcs and humans from green-screen terminals.
It is no board game: it is a world of epic fantasy, with magic, heroes and monsters. Every turn, all the kingdoms move at once.
